articles.title: Rapists and child sex offenders to be barred from early release scheme
articles.description: The widow of PC Andrew Harper says it is "disgusting" her husband's killers remain eligible for the scheme in England and Wales.

articles.title: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
articles.description: Three children were killed when the drone crashed at a popular resort on the Black Sea.

articles.title: Infantino opponents threaten 'non co-operation' with Fifa
articles.description: The English Football Association is set to join Wales in withdrawing backing for Infantino's bid to continue as Fifa president.

articles.title: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
articles.description: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.
